b1-unit-01.01.1 Ana meets Danny:
Narrator: Danny, Rita's son, is in São Paulo at the start of his gap year. Rita asked Ana to show him around, so they meet at a café.
Ana: So, Danny, where are you from? Chicago, right?
Danny: Yes, I was born and grew up in Chicago.
Ana: Really? Whereabouts in Chicago?
Danny: Near City Coffee. My mom manages it. I think you know it.
Ana: Yes! I went there when I visited Tom. Have you been to Brazil before?
Danny: No, this is my first time. But I had a great vacation in Mexico last year.
Ana: And what do you do?
Danny: I'm taking a gap year before college. I worked at a supermarket for months to save money. What about you?
Ana: I'm a doctor at a hospital here in São Paulo.
Danny: A doctor? Do you enjoy your work?
Ana: Yes, I do. It's hard, but I love helping people. Right now, I'm also studying for an English test.
Danny: An English test? Your English is great. How long have you been learning?
Ana: Oh, for about ten years. My online teacher is in Chicago. His name is Tom.
Danny: Tom? Lucy's roommate? So he's a mutual friend!
Ana: Ha! It's a small world. Do you travel much?
Danny: Not really, but this year I'm traveling around South America. Have you ever been to Peru?
Ana: Yes, I have, actually. I went there two years ago. The food was fantastic.
b1-unit-01.01.2 Kate meets Yuki:
Narrator: At Sweet Kate Bakery in Chicago, Kate is talking to a customer.
Kate: So, is this your first time in Chicago?
Yuki: Yes, it is.
Kate: When did you get here?
Yuki: On Monday.
Kate: On Monday? And how long are you here for?
Yuki: Just a week.
Kate: Oh, that's a shame! You need more time to really get to know the city. Where are you staying?
Yuki: At a hotel near the river.
Kate: Nice. Your English is really good. How long have you been learning it?
Yuki: About ten years. My teacher in Tokyo is from New York. Have you been there?
Kate: Not yet, but I have a few friends there.
Yuki: So what do you do in your free time?
Kate: Well, I love baking, of course! And I walk my dog, Pepper, by the lake every morning. How about you? Do you do any sports?
Yuki: Yes, I do aikido.
Kate: Really? Are you any good?
Yuki: Ha! I'm OK.
